cells.exact_wording: everything is promoted because operational evidence demonstrated necessity
cells.source_claim: promotion occurs only on demonstrated operational evidence
cells.notes: Universal rule: promotion is grounded in demonstrated operational evidence. It does NOT state when the condition is checked (at authorization t_a vs at the promotion event t_p), nor that the bar is re-met at the event; so it cannot decide the event-time propositions. Coding it SUPPORTED would eliminate MT1-P1 (EP-02a) or the whole family (EP-02b) on unstated timing — ambiguity kept explicit.

cells.notes: Forward-only ladder; the entry states no reverse transition (no demotion, revocation, invalidation, reassessment). SILENT on post-promotion loss — and absence is not persistence (¬E(revocation) ⇏ P0).
